title.en: UCLA explores turning campus waste into hydrogen
title.zh: UCLA把校园废物变成氢能的试验

summary.en: A university–company pilot studies whether a daily waste stream can supply fuel and store carbon; its power and vehicle figures are projections.
summary.zh: 大学与企业试验如何把日常废料转为燃料并储存碳；供电及车辆数字属于估算。

title.en: A restaurant software bill becomes a court question
title.zh: 餐厅软件账单走进法庭

summary.en: The FTC and states sue Toast over alleged charges and cancellation practices; the filed complaint puts the claims before a federal court.
summary.zh: FTC与多州起诉Toast，指控收费和取消订阅问题；诉状已交由联邦法院审理。
